open_faults.fault: mixed-universe bots mark and rank their CRYPTO holdings at the previous UTC day's close on any US weekday before the equity feed lands
open_faults.detail: Root cause unchanged: hunter_tracker.fetch() calls market_hours.trim_incomplete_bars() on a frame holding equities beside crypto, and on a weekday whose equity columns are still all-NaN the trim drops the trailing row and takes the live crypto column with it. It cannot fire today because it is Sunday and weekend rows are deliberately kept: hunter's 1032.42 implies SOL near 106.70 against a live 106.3-106.4, so the mark is honest right now. Expect it to re-arm at Monday's pre-open. The 08-24 judgment filed against it closed NEUTRAL because the bot never traded in the window, which means the fault was never exercised, not that it was resolved. Owner decides; supervisor does not touch code.

open_faults.fault: entry rules with no price filter on the two euphoria-driven books (sentiment, hypecrypto)
open_faults.status: OPEN, NEW this run, mechanism measured
open_faults.detail: Not a code bug but a design defect, and it is now measured on both books in the same week. hypecrypto bought PROM at 7.266 into a 3.63-to-7.89 six-day run and stopped at 6.427, 1.4% off the day's low; sentiment bought NVDA at 226.78, 1.1% under the day's 229.26 high, and closed 4.07% down the same session. Both rules take the symbol a scan names and pay the prevailing price, which is by construction after the move that made it euphoric. The controlled comparison is in-fleet: the real-money lottery book screens candidates on distance from the 24h low, entered AUCTION on 08-30 and is up 17.1%. Combined damage since the 08-24 run is 286.32 across the two books. Reported, not touched.

open_faults.fault: analyst price-feed date alignment does not match the reference feed
open_faults.detail: The agent's own decision text quotes SPY closing 769.72 on 8/27 and 771.90 on 8/28; Yahoo has 771.10 and 769.35 for those dates. The two values are close to each other but transposed across the two sessions, so this is not a clean one-day lag. It changes nothing today because both readings sit roughly 15 points above the agent's 755.00 abort line, and its reasoning validated true and its falsifier did not fire. Worth confirming before the feed matters near a threshold.
